scripts.build:backend: npm run build -w @greensite/contracts && npm run build -w @greensite/backend
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build -w greensite-ems
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:backend && npm run typecheck -w greensite-ems
scripts.format: prettier --write backend/common backend/services backend/tests packages/contracts/src frontend/app frontend/components/ems frontend/tests frontend/hooks frontend/lib scripts *.json compose.yaml
scripts.format:check: prettier --check backend/common backend/services backend/tests packages/contracts/src frontend/app frontend/components/ems frontend/tests frontend/hooks frontend/lib scripts *.json compose.yaml
